realtime.existing: WebSocket (/api/v1/health/ws) + SSE (/api/v1/health/stream) with reconnect, sequence numbers, heartbeat

websocket_sse_differences.existing: Full implementation with ConnectionManager, sequence numbers, heartbeat, stale detection, reconnect handling, ack/sync messages
websocket_sse_differences.reusable: Existing WebSocket/SSE implementation can be adapted for React with minimal changes

migration_matrix.reason: Figma is designated as canonical new UI per Phase 40 requirements
components_to_migrate_from_existing: API service layer (health, attendance, student, timetable, excel, enrollment)
Pinia store patterns → React Context + hooks or Zustand
components_to_keep_from_figma: All UI components (design system, liquid-glass styling)

duplicate_routes.search: Both have person search (SearchView vs PersonSearch)

recommendation: Migrate existing frontend's API integration, WebSocket/SSE, and business logic into Figma's React architecture. Keep Figma's design system and UI components. Build missing UI for timetable, parent/telegram, and Excel in Figma's design language.
